title: Wolt Ads for Merchants | Pay Only Per Order - Wolt (Luxembourg)

facts.fact: Wolt says launching a Wolt Ads campaign takes just 5 clicks to go live.
A later heading on the same Wolt page says a sponsored listing ad campaign can be launched in 6 clicks, which conflicts with the 5-click claim.
facts.quote: Launch your ad in 6 clicks — track results anytime, day or night

facts.fact: Wolt states that, on average, 60% of customers click on the top venues.
facts.quote: **60%**click on the top venues, on average

facts.fact: Wolt states that merchants earn 6x the amount invested in Wolt Ads, on average.
facts.quote: Earn **6x** the amount invested, on average

facts.fact: Wolt says Sponsored Listings are charged only for completed orders, not for clicks.
facts.quote: Place your venue in top spots across the Wolt app and boost visibility where it matters most — on the discovery page, in search results, and more. Only pay for completed orders, not clicks.

facts.fact: A Wolt partner testimonial reports that over 30% of orders during its Wolt Ads campaign came from first-time users, and the partner paid only when they ordered.
facts.quote: During our Wolt Ads campaign, over 30% of orders came from first-time users — and we only paid when they ordered.

facts.fact: Wolt says the combined Sponsored Listings and Promos offering is fully pay-per-order.
facts.quote: It’s a powerful combo — fully pay-per-order.

facts.fact: Wolt offers a free trial for merchants to start Wolt Ads, with a sign-up link on the page.
Wolt says merchants can reach customers through off-app media across Meta, TikTok, Google and its Electric Vehicles, beyond the Wolt App.
facts.quote: On the Wolt App and beyond — like across Meta, TikTok, Google and our Electric Vehicles.

facts.fact: Wolt says merchants get real-time reporting and campaign performance insights in the Merchant Portal to optimize marketing spend.
facts.quote: Access real time reporting and campaign performance insights to continually optimize your marketing spend.
